title: Yi-Ping T NDEs 13168 NDE 13168
content: The first near death experience happened to me when I was age 21. I went to the hot springs and then my heart suddenly stopped. I had no heart-beat for 5 minutes. I woke up with help from people surrounding me. I saw the shadows of my grandparents and a little girl, whom I couldn't recognize who she was. I was in a completely dark place. The second near death experience happened when I was age 28. I was meeting with my colleagues at McDonald's. I drank 5 cups of coffee, not thinking about my health. This caused me to have a heart attack. My heart was born abnormal. I passed out. Then I saw a bright light and heard beautiful music from heaven. Everything was shining like gold, even though I didn't know what it was. After I woke up, I was in the hospital already. The third near death experience happened when I was age 32. I was walking with a foal in the horse ranch. The fool's legs accidentally kicked my chest. I couldn't breathe and my heart suddenly stopped. What I remembered was that I fell on the ground. Only a few seconds later, I saw myself in the sky and I flew as a balloon. At the same time, I was very confused about seeing my body lying on the grass. My colleagues tried to help me. I was happy and fearless because I saw the blue sky and clouds. I even could feel the breeze. I saw everything so clearly. I didn't even care if I was dead or alive. Around 5 seconds later, I started fall like an airplane crashing to the ground. I felt like I was buried in the deep ground. I tried to push away the soil and got out from the underground. After I woke up, my colleagues told me that they thought I was dead because my heart stopped for more than 10 minutes. After the doctor checked on me, he told me that it was a miracle because my heart attack didn't affect my pregnancy - my baby was still alive. I am 52 now and my son just barely turned to 19. My daughter is almost 18 years old. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: 1994, 2001, 2005 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Accident Illness Heart attack Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function) The first one, I was soaking inside the hot springs. The second one, I drank too much coffee that caused a heart attack. The third one, I was accidently kicked by a foal in the horse veterinarian's ranch in California. How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I saw my colleagues running around and trying to help me. I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal. My five senses are more sensitive. I feel my spirit as a glove covers my body. Sometimes I can sense unusual spirits around me. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? The third near death experience Were your thoughts speeded up? Faster than usual Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Time seemed to go faster or slower than usual. Everything was slow motion. Were your senses More vivid than usual? Incredibly more vivid Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. During Near death experience, my vision was perfect, no need for wearing glasses. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I felt calm, peaceful, more sensitive Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? Yes, and the facts have been checked out Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? I actually saw them Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? Yes Grandparents and a little girl. Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Yes The light was bright as shining gold and warm. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Some unfamiliar and strange place The path was shining as gold, all plants were singing and waving. What emotions did you feel during the experience? I felt calm and peaceful. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt united or one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe. I felt I was not alone anymore. Did scenes from your past come back to you? I remembered many past events. I remembered every detail when the accident happened. Did scenes from the future come to you? Scenes from the world's future. I can sense an earthquake before it comes. I can sense some church friends while they passed away. I even got invited to join a party in the heavens by a formal pastor who was an Romanian while he just passed away. Did you come to a border or point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will. I didn't want to come back because it was so beautiful. But someone sent me back to life. God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Buddhist I was in the darkness when my spirit left my body. Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Yes From none religion to Christian What is your religion now? Christian- Protestant I saw lights, heard music from heaven, met my ancestors. Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes I used to have serious depression, but now I feel happy every single day. Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? I heard a voice I could not identify. I heard the music and singing was from the heavens. Did you see deceased or religious spirits? I actually saw them Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? Uncertain I knew it was God. During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? Yes I met some people were so familiar while my body was dead. During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? Yes I could sense a lot of spirits around. During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? Yes I could sense I was not alone. Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Yes I knew we had a purpose on the earth. During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? Yes God sent me back to life for some reasons. It looked like my job was not done. During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? Yes My spirit is alive even though my body is dead. Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? Yes I felt love from heaven. What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Large changes in my life Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes I treat people with God's love. After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Yes I can communicate with horses. Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? I understand I am very special. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes I share my experience with my family and friends. They thought it was incredible. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real. I thought it was amazing experience. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real It was a wonderful wake up call. At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? Yes I had three times near death experiences. e0k9i1x_nde
